name: Cellev8 Nutrition Inc.
summary: Cellev8 Nutrition, Inc., established on March 19, 1999, by Michael A. Ferraro, specializes in providing distinctive educational programs and digital games for children. The company's core mission is to tackle the issue of childhood obesity and foster informed, healthy nutritional choices among young individuals. Cellev8 Nutrition's operations are based out of its headquarters in Wellington, Florida.
